submission.justification: No option was demonstrated to satisfy all hard constraints because the recorded search found no explicit pion/kaon separation values or simulation grid points for any radiator/thickness combination. Radiator-R2 is disqualified by the humidity-ageing hard requirement (40% loss > 10%). Among the humidity-compliant candidates, Radiator-R1 has the lowest recorded ageing loss (3%, versus 6% for R3). A 6 cm thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range and is the conservative choice for maximizing Cherenkov photon statistics in the absence of usable separation results. Therefore this is only a provisional recommendation; the 3.5 sigma separation requirement remains unverified and no fully compliant option can be certified from the available results.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: No explicit pion/kaon separation values were found, no candidate-thickness separation grid points were found, and no viable options were considered by the recorded selection step.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R1 is one of the three allowed candidates; R1_allowed = 1 and R1 candidate-listed checks passed for all checked thicknesses.

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: For R1 at all checked thicknesses, separation_value_available = 0 and separation_pass = 0; num_explicit_pion_kaon_separation_values_found = 0. The hard requirement is therefore not demonstrated.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: R1_humidity_loss_percent = 3, which is below the 10% maximum; R1 humidity checks passed for all checked thicknesses.
Selected thickness is 6 cm, equal to the allowed maximum; min_allowed_thickness_cm = 1 and max_allowed_thickness_cm = 6.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Radiator-R1 with thickness 6 cm, while noting that no fully compliant option can be certified because the separation requirement is unverified.
